rules.message: A workout can't be logged with a date in the future.
rules.check: const d = row.day instanceof Date ? row.day.toISOString().slice(0,10) : String(row.day).slice(0,10); const today = ctx.now().toISOString().slice(0,10); if (d > today) return "A workout can't be logged with a date in the future."; return true;

const d = row.day instanceof Date ? row.day.toISOString().slice(0,10) : String(row.day).slice(0,10); const today = ctx.now().toISOString().slice(0,10); if (d > today) return "You can't check in for a future day."; try { const r = (await ctx.db.query('select 1 from checkin where athlete_id = $1 and day = $2 limit 1', [row.athlete_id, d])) as unknown as { rows?: unknown[] }; const n = Array.isArray(r) ? r.length : (r.rows || []).length; if (n > 0) return "You've already checked in today."; } catch (e) { return true; } return true;

do.code: const d = (v: unknown): string => (v instanceof Date ? v.toISOString().slice(0, 10) : String(v).slice(0, 10)); const now = ctx.now(); const startIso = new Date(now.getTime() - 7 * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10); const aths = await ctx.db.list('athlete'); const wos = await ctx.db.list('workout'); const cks = await ctx.db.list('checkin'); for (const a of aths) { const id = String(a.id); const w = wos.filter((x) => String(x.athlete_id) === id && d(x.day) >= startIso); const c = cks.filter((x) => String(x.athlete_id) === id && d(x.day) >= startIso); const minutes = w.reduce((s, x) => s + Number(x.duration_min || 0), 0); const volume = w.reduce((s, x) => s + Number(x.volume || 0), 0); const eff = w.length ? Math.round((w.reduce((s, x) => s + Number(x.effort || 0), 0) / w.length) * 10) / 10 : 0; const sleep = c.length ? Math.round((c.reduce((s, x) => s + Number(x.sleep_hours || 0), 0) / c.length) * 10) / 10 : 0; const summary = String(a.name) + ': ' + w.length + ' sessions, ' + minutes + ' min, ' + volume + ' kg lifted, avg effort ' + eff + '/10, ' + c.length + ' check-ins, avg sleep ' + sleep + ' h.'; await ctx.db.create('digest', { athlete_id: id, coach_id: a.coach_id ? String(a.coach_id) : null, week_start: startIso, sessions: w.length, minutes: minutes, volume: volume, avg_effort: eff, checkins: c.length, avg_sleep: sleep, summary: summary }); } ctx.notify({ title: 'Weekly digest is ready', body: 'Your training summary for the last 7 days has been written.' });
